eps.o: Georgie and Mandy get fed up living with her parents, the McCallisters.
Georgie struggles to balance life, work and family; Mandy worries for Georgie's wellbeing; and Missy gets into trouble at school.

eps.t: Secrets, Lies and a Chunk of Change
eps.o: Georgie digs into Mandy's past when he discovers she's been hiding thousands of dollars of debt. Meanwhile, Mandy tries to right her wrongs by going back to work.

Things get awkward when Georgie and Mandy try to make new friends. Meanwhile, Jim and Audrey get competitive playing a game with Connor. Mandy befriends Beth, a fellow waitress at the diner, who is looking for fun in the wake of her recent divorce.
Mandy struggles to get Georgie's family to join him for his first Thanksgiving without his dad.
Georgie joins a church to sell tires to the congregation and Mandy worries there is more to it than that.
Georgie worries that he's leaving Connor out of his new project with Jim. Meanwhile, Mandy and Audrey struggle to decorate CeeCee's nursery without fighting.
Tensions rise when Georgie intrudes on Mandy's new sales gig. Meanwhile, Audrey's conflicted when Jim makes it a point not to coddle Connor.

eps.t: A Tire Convention and the Moral High Ground
eps.o: Georgie discovers that Jim's annual tire convention trip isn't what he says it is. Meanwhile, Mandy has doubts about the strength of her and Georgie's marriage.
Audrey and Mary go to war over CeeCee and Georgie, and Mandy can't help but take sides.
Audrey's past rears its head when Georgie leaves the tire store to work for Fred Fagenbacher, Jim's longtime nemesis, and Mandy struggles to keep peace in the house.
Georgie worries he's letting his family down when he's forced to stay home with a cold, and Mandy worries about how her career will affect her marriage.
Jim feels ganged up on when Georgie and Audrey make changes to the tire store, and Mandy helps Georgie navigate a fight between her parents.
Mandy finds out Meemaw runs an illegal sportsbook and decides she wants in on the action. Meanwhile, Georgie struggles to keep Mandy's new job a secret.
Georgie helps Connor impress his new crush, while Mandy, Audrey and Jim struggle to butt out of Connor's love life.
Georgie and Mandy worry they're not on the same page when they disagree about having another kid, and Mary, Jim and Audrey struggle to stay out of it.

eps.t: Two Idiots on a Dirt Bike
eps.o: Georgie's attempt to break up Missy and her new boyfriend backfires.
Mandy tries to prove she's financially responsible after Jim and Georgie call out her poor spending habits, and Connor's new girlfriend needs a place to stay.
Mandy has to help Meemaw collect money from her dad when he loses some bets, while Georgie tries to intervene between his grandmother and his father-in-law.
Georgie tries to juggle his mom, his mother-in-law and Mandy on Mother's Day. Meanwhile, Audrey wants to meet Connor's girlfriend.
Georgie panics when he learns that Jim is considering selling the tire store to his rival, and Mandy's forced to confront a long-running lie.
Tensions rise when Georgie finds out the truth about Mandy's boss, and Georgie does all he can to buy the tire store before Jim sells it.
